# viewport

```go
import "github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/viewport"
```

Package viewport is scrollable text the app sizes: wrapped at its width or panned sideways, with a gutter, a style per line and search highlights.

<a name="GutterRow"></a>
## type [GutterRow](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/viewport/viewport.go#L80-L84>)

GutterRow is what a gutter function is asked to draw for one row.

```go
type GutterRow struct {
    Line      int  // the content line, from 0; Lines or more on a row past the end
    Lines     int  // how many lines the content has
    Continued bool // a wrapped line's second row or later
}
```

<a name="Keys"></a>
## type [Keys](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/viewport/viewport.go#L29-L33>)

Keys are the bindings that scroll and pan. Down, Right, PageDown and the rest have no help of their own: Up's, Left's and PageUp's name them.

```go
type Keys struct {
    Up, Down, Left, Right                      key.Binding
    PageUp, PageDown, HalfPageUp, HalfPageDown key.Binding
    Top, Bottom                                key.Binding
}
```

<a name="DefaultKeys"></a>
### func [DefaultKeys](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/viewport/viewport.go#L37>)

```go
func DefaultKeys() Keys
```

DefaultKeys are the arrows, pgup/pgdown and home/end; half a page has no key until an app gives it one.

<a name="Model.EnsureVisible"></a>
### func \(Model\) [EnsureVisible](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/viewport/viewport.go#L331>)

```go
func (m Model) EnsureVisible(line, colStart, colEnd int) Model
```

EnsureVisible scrolls line to the top unless it shows already, and pans to a step left of colStart unless colEnd fits from the left edge. Before the viewport has a size nothing shows, so nothing moves.

<a name="Model.SetHighlights"></a>
### func \(Model\) [SetHighlights](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/viewport/highlight.go#L64>)

```go
func (m Model) SetHighlights(matches [][]int) Model
```

SetHighlights paints matches: byte ranges into the content's plain text, escape sequences stripped, in order and not overlapping, as regexp.FindAllStringIndex returns them. It shows the first at or below the top.

<a name="Model.SetLines"></a>
### func \(Model\) [SetLines](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/viewport/viewport.go#L157>)

```go
func (m Model) SetLines(lines []string) Model
```

SetLines shows lines, copied. CRLF and lone CRs break lines too, and a tab becomes spaces to the next multiple of four cells, which a width can count.

```go
func (m Model) WithGutter(f func(GutterRow) string) Model
```

WithGutter draws f's text before every row, kept in place while panning: line numbers, marks. Every row's must be as wide as f\(GutterRow\{\}\); nil removes it.

<a name="Styles"></a>
## type [Styles](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/viewport/viewport.go#L51-L54>)

Styles are how search matches are painted.

```go
type Styles struct {
    Match   lipgloss.Style // every match
    Current lipgloss.Style // the match the reader is on
}
```
